scope: Stage 3-B B3.2 HWPX picture lineShape eligibility stabilization
stage3b: COMPLETED within the documented supported subset
rootCause: The picture reader checked style, color and width. It could classify NONE with unmodeled attributes as borderless, while the HWPX picture writer omits lineShape.

supportedDefaults.explicitElement: One empty lineShape with explicit NONE. XML whitespace in a paired empty tag is allowed.
supportedDefaults.basis: Pinned RHWP ShapeBorderLine::default, parse_line_shape_attr and write_line_shape. The OWPML LineShapeType schema declares FLAT as an attribute default, while RHWP models an unset cap as ROUND. An explicit FLAT value is unsupported by the portable picture contract.

rejected: Visible SOLID, DASH and DOT including width zero, non-default caps/arrows/fill/sizes/outline/alpha, unknown or malformed values, missing style, duplicate attributes or elements and child properties. The getter continues to signal borderType=-1 for those modeled pictures.

baselineDiagnostic.case: NONE with explicit FLAT endCap returned borderType=0

releaseWasm.initialBuild: Exit 1 due to the quick-xml BytesText call. Corrected and rebuilt from verified patched inputs.

verification.command: node_modules/.bin/vitest run --config scripts/tests/vitest.config.ts stage3-hwpx-clipboard-safety.wasm.test.ts -t 'preserves a borderless picture|picture lineShape safety|handles real HWPX picture metadata'

regressions.refusalProof: Real HWPX XML reaches the Release parser. Copy yields a same-document envelope without portable data, cross-document paste is refused before insertion, and destination and source identity, body, history, resources, font inventory and serialization stay intact.
regressions.roundTripProof: Cross-document copy/paste, Undo restoring original target bytes, Redo, exportHwpxWithReport with no loss, and reopen in a separate Release document preserve ownership, MIME, image bytes, natural and picture dimensions, crop edges and imgClip, and styled caption paragraph order with one owned atno.

native.reason: The production change is in the source HWPX parser eligibility gate. Real Release WASM clipboard tests cover refusal and successful export/reopen; UI and destination save paths were unchanged.
